OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WITH DISTINCT p, t, CAST(STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d') AS DATE) AS birthdate
WITH p, t,
     2026 - DATE_PART('year', birthdate) -
     CASE
       WHEN DATE_PART('month', birthdate) > 10

       THEN 1 ELSE 0

   OR (t.team_name = 'Detroit Pistons' AND p.college = 'Temple University')
